### 🔋 Electrolite Test Details

### ✅ Test Checklist
- [ ] **Balanced Mode (80% Cap)** works correctly (capping charge at 80%).
- [ ] **Electrolite Mode (100% Cap)** works correctly (removing cap).
- [ ] **Battery telemetry** (percentage, power source, charging status) updates correctly in the dashboard.
- [ ] **Global Hotkey** (`Ctrl + Shift + B`) cycles the modes correctly.

Add any comments, observations, or suggestions you have here.
